b0117-text-01.machineText: *使用描述性方案名称*——使用`mycompany-myapp`，而不是`mca`

b0118-text-01.machineText: *验证所有输入*——切勿信任来自外部来源的 URL
b0118-text-01.sourcePreview: *Validate all input* - Never trust URLs from external sources

b0119-text-01.machineText: *妥善处理错误*——记录无效 URL，不要让应用崩溃
b0119-text-01.sourcePreview: *Handle errors gracefully* - Log invalid URLs, don't crash

b0120-text-01.machineText: *向用户提供反馈*——显示触发了什么操作
b0120-text-01.sourcePreview: *Provide user feedback* - Show what action was triggered

b0121-text-01.machineText: *在所有平台上测试*——协议处理方式因平台而异
b0121-text-01.sourcePreview: *Test on all platforms* - Protocol handling varies

b0122-text-01.machineText: *记录 URL 结构*——为用户和集成人员提供帮助
b0122-text-01.sourcePreview: *Document your URL structure* - Help users and integrators

b0124-text-01.machineText: *不要使用常见的协议方案名称*——避免使用`http`、`file`、`app`等名称
b0124-text-01.sourcePreview: *Don't use common scheme names* - Avoid `http`, `file`, `app`, etc.

b0125-text-01.machineText: *不要将 URL 作为代码执行*——这会带来巨大的安全风险
b0125-text-01.sourcePreview: *Don't execute URLs as code* - Huge security risk

b0126-text-01.machineText: *不要暴露敏感操作*——执行破坏性操作前必须要求用户确认
b0126-text-01.sourcePreview: *Don't expose sensitive operations* - Require confirmation for destructive actions

b0127-text-01.machineText: *不要假定协议在任何环境中都能正常工作*——应提供备用机制
b0127-text-01.sourcePreview: *Don't assume protocols work everywhere* - Have fallback mechanisms

b0128-text-01.machineText: *不要忘记 URL 编码*——正确处理特殊字符
b0128-text-01.sourcePreview: *Don't forget URL encoding* - Handle special characters properly
